questions.prompt: In pretraining, what does a language model learn to do?

options.text: Predict the next word from the words before it.
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic's glossary says pretrained models learn to predict the next word, given the text before it.

options.text: Look up facts in a database for each question.
options.explanation: Pretraining is learning patterns from text, not building a lookup table of facts.

options.text: Follow instructions perfectly from the start.
options.explanation: The glossary says pretrained models are not good at following instructions yet. Fine-tuning and RLHF come after.

options.text: All the text the model was trained on.
options.explanation: The docs say the context window is different from the training data.

options.text: The model's "working memory": your prompt, files, the chat so far and the reply.
options.explanation: Right. It is everything the model can look at while it writes this answer.

options.text: The window in the app where you type.
options.explanation: It is not a part of the screen. It is the text the model can use for this answer.

questions.prompt: You ask the same question twice and get two different answers. Is something broken?

options.text: Yes. The same prompt should always give the same answer.
options.explanation: The vendors' docs say model output is non-deterministic, so different answers are expected.

options.text: No. LLM output can change from run to run, even for the same prompt.
options.explanation: Right. Plan for variation and check the outputs.
